registry.name: Platform Requirements Registry
registry.scope: The platform: the substrate and its bead contracts, the factory (intake, dispatch, verification, merge), execution and scheduling, trust and reversibility, delivery and CI, and assurance. A product built on the platform is out of scope and belongs in its own registry.
registry.purpose: Give platform work something testable to cite. Every dev.task names the requirement criteria it serves in requirement_refs; scripts/check-repo-invariants.py resolves each citation against this directory and fails on a dangling one.

companion_registry.boundary: REG-LIFEOPS owns what the example vertical must do. REG-PLATFORM owns what the machine that builds and runs it must do. A requirement belongs here if it would still be true were the vertical replaced by a different product.

registry.method: This file is an example in the shape the tooling validates. An operator replaces it with requirements reverse-engineered from their own system; every conformance verdict then cites a file:line, a merged PR, or a command run during the measuring pass.

conformance_legend.pass: Verified working against code inspection or a command run during the measuring pass.
conformance_legend.fail: Verified broken or verifiably not meeting the criterion.
conformance_legend.unverified: Plausibly implemented; not exercised. Do not treat as passing.

status_legend.partial: Built, conforms to some acceptance criteria only.
status_legend.defective: Built, but measures or does the wrong thing.

source_legend.derived-from-implementation: Intent inferred from code, docstrings and merged PR bodies.
source_legend.operating-record: Derived from something that happened on a stated date.
source_legend.architecture-mandated: Required by ARCHITECTURE.md, stated here as a testable criterion.
source_legend.analyst-proposed: Proposed to close a gap; not yet approved by the owner.

registry.verdict_discipline: Conformance verdicts are dated snapshots of the system as observed on the measuring date. Sprints burn them down. Do not edit a verdict to match today's code; record a new observation instead. A verdict that is silently corrected destroys the measurement it exists to provide.

capabilities.name: Substrate
capabilities.summary: One store for beads, their edges, their provenance and their lifecycle.

capabilities.name: Factory
capabilities.summary: Turning a filed intent into a reviewed, merged change without a human in each step.

capabilities.name: Execution
capabilities.summary: Durable orchestration and scheduling of the work the platform performs.

capabilities.name: Trust
capabilities.summary: Whether a change can be undone, whether a claim can be traced, and whether a secret stays one.

capabilities.name: Delivery
capabilities.summary: Getting a merged commit onto the cluster, reproducibly and reversibly.

capabilities.name: Assurance
capabilities.summary: Knowing what the platform is doing, and being able to get it back.

capabilities.name: Inference
capabilities.summary: Model calls: one path, attributable, and with capacity distinguishable from failure.

requirements.title: The model, its derivations, and the substrate reconcile mechanically

requirements.rationale: Hand-maintained mirrors and hand-copied derivable facts are the two rot vectors the EA practice exists to close. requirements.title: Release health is a managed record with a lifecycle, a declared policy, an honest coverage and a recorded disposition
requirements.rationale: The owner's ask: 'alignment/visibility into the Health of the current release.' Measured at one revision: activities/release_status.py mints one dated arch.observation per release per day (many active, none read) with every number in unvalidated context and no notify path; the fixture release stood at blocking 81.8% vs 10% declared with risk and security ABSENT and nobody told; task-level rework and gate coverage (0 dev.release records) are visible nowhere; CAP-ASR declares alerting and no PC-ASR record covers an alert. The record must be a governed type with a state machine (arch.incident/arch.risk precedent), measured by the admitted measures edge, thresholds in a fenced document under a loader, alerts that transition and dedupe without permanent silence (the fixture release/O-13), unknown never rendered as zero or on_track (the fixture release/O-6), a disposition that moves state (PRIN-017). The governed-type mechanism is analyst design.

acceptance_criteria.given: the committed fixture, docs/releases/policy/health-policy.json, and a store double that refuses a second create for one ref, refuses a PATCH from any identity other than factory-dispatcher/release-status, and refuses a transition not in the registered machine
acceptance_criteria.when: the reconciler runs six times over the fixture for the fixture release: twice at header.captured_at, at +1h and +2h over unchanged inputs, then twice at header.midpoint_day, where a new signal (class_absent) holds
acceptance_criteria.then: exactly one arch.release_health bead with ref health.<ref> and a measures edge exists; run one (now = header.captured_at) creates health.<ref> at unmeasured, writes one measures link from the health bead to the release bead, and transitions unmeasured -> on_track (every holding condition is pending on a first measurement): exactly create + add_link + transition_state; run two (now = header.captured_at, unchanged inputs) PATCHes content with class_over_share ['blocking'] fired (header.expected_class_over_share) and transitions on_track -> drifting once by compare-and-set within the registered machine -- hysteresis fires on the second sight, so run two is not a zero-write run; runs three and four (+1h and +2h, unchanged inputs) write nothing, because the fingerprint is equal despite the moving clock; run five (now = header.midpoint_day, where class_absent holds for the fixture release's risk and security per header.expected_class_absent_at_midpoint) PATCHes content with class_absent recorded pending=true and performs no transition; run six (now = header.midpoint_day) PATCHes content with class_absent fired=true and transitions drifting -> breached once by compare-and-set within the registered machine, class_absent being impact high (re-specified <date> to the hysteresis-correct sequence a sprint item AC-3 states in the same words)
acceptance_criteria.verification: not measured in this example registry

requirements.title: A release's changes, the applications they touched and the verdicts that admitted them are typed records reachable from the release
requirements.rationale: The north-star framing (CSDM, Ardoq, ServiceNow): an initiative relates to the records it changes. Measured at one revision: change_apply._ensure_change_edges (:592-616) writes arch.change --delivers--> arch.release and --affects--> arch.application, but resolve_release_binding (:532-545) finds the task via find_task_by_pr_url (:301-305), which reads content.pr_refs — set only by --bind-pr (dispatch.py:4971-4975) — while the normal PR exit writes content.pr_url (dispatch_steps.py:1145). At that read most done tasks carry pr_url, few pr_refs, and the newest changes carry affects but no delivers edges (changes fixture header records the counts); every change's evidence says 'dev.release has no writer yet'; dev.release is inventoried (bead-object-inventory.md:42) with no schema, machine or beads. PRIN-003.

requirements.title: A retry knows why its predecessor failed
requirements.rationale: fail_task writes the failure reason to the bead as a note of kind 'status', body 'Run failed: <reason>'; build_prompt surfaces only answered question pairs, selecting notes whose content carries kind == 'answer'. No selector in build_prompt matches kind == 'status', so the failure record is never read back and every attempt after the first begins from a standing start. record_capacity_failure writes the same kind with body 'Capacity backpressure: ...', and capacity is explicitly not a work failure, so a reader selecting on kind alone would misreport backpressure as failure. Measured <date>: 45 preserved failure patches across 16 beads, 11 beads at three or more attempts, and cd5e27ce failing six times against a spec later shown unsatisfiable by construction. PC-FAC-004 covers the write side of this record and an earlier change made it richer; nothing covered the read side. See ARCHITECTURE.md Amendment 29 (RATIFIED <date>). Burnt down the same day by an earlier change; AC-1..AC-3 re-measured below.

requirements.title: A declared state machine governs every write that changes state
requirements.rationale: ARCHITECTURE.md Sec 3.1 names the legal edges of a bead's lifecycle. A machine that is declared but never consulted is documentation, not a control: it reads as a guarantee to everyone downstream while permitting the edge it forbids. The gap only becomes visible when something writes an illegal edge and nothing objects, which is a bad moment to learn the control was advisory.
